notes.title: Animation Studio Manager Full Release on Friday
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Animators!
[/h2]
In case you missed the level 10 update last week, the game is now content complete!

[b]Hurray!! Celebration![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/f627d2511f7c811007954cdf072fac516f086e1e.png[/img]

Today I updated the store page with a new trailer, screenshots and GIFs to make sure everything is up-to-date and accurate and ready to go for Friday's official launch. Minus any final balancing and polishing over the next few days, the full game is now done. 

Of course, if you don't want to wait for Friday, you can pick up the Early Access copy of the game now, which will be updated on Friday to the full version - the choice is yours!

[h3]Good luck winning the Golden T-Pose Award Show!![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/b573180eb441bb70004afd4841dac089d21b7930.png[/img]

notes.title: Hot Fix for today's small update

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
There was a glitch that was crashing the game, so I am posting an update that fixes it. There are a few other little balances as well:

 [list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would crash the game during the Paparazzi game if you played in Easy Mode, had both Writer upgrades, and waited until the timer ran out on a question.
[*] Clarified some wording throughout.
[*] 3 new Level 9 Achievements
[*] Fixed a glitch that prevented some of the Barista Extras & Sweeteners from being impacted by the Catch A Break Coffee Perk boost. 
[*] Fan Convention - Ads/Deals were not being properly deducted when you used them for a Fan Convention.
[*] Added the character vocals (like when you click on a desk or office door) when you enter the Barista area, or when Chad pulls you into a Meeting.
[*] Extra Credit - Approvals have been reduced to match the previous adjustments that were made to balancing. 
[*] Entourage 
[list]
[*] Added some clarity about using your Entourage Points,
[*] Added graphic/audio feedback when you spend the points.
[*] Added text update when you have fully upgraded your Entourage.
[/list]
[*] "Skip To Friday"
[list]
[*] This wasn't very visible before, so now it has replaced the obsolete "Help" button above the play/pause toggle at the bottom-left of the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue when skipping to Friday during New Years.
[*] When you hover over it, a little message pops up, explaining either why you can't use it now, or what will happen if you DO use it.
[list]
[*] You can't use it if it's already Friday, for obvious reasons.
[*] You can't use it if you have an Award Ceremony on Monday
[*] And you can't use it during the level 1 tutorial.
[/list]
[*] Added a new "Skip to Friday" sound effect.
[/list]
[*] Player Avatar
[list]
[*] Added Player reflection on the Office Computer Screen
[*] Added Eye & Eyelid animation to the Player Avatars (except the OMBd one, because that is a picture)
[/list]
[*] Award Show
[list]
[*] The Gold Bar that appears by the winner's points now has 3 variations for clarity.
[list]
[*] If a normal opponent wins, the Bar is the normal, plain gold bar.
[*] If YOU win, it is a gold bar with two Stars on it.
[*] If MOM wins, it is a gold bar that says "MOM"
[/list]
[*] The first time you're going through the Level 7 Award Show and Mom is guiding you, you can't automatically "Skip to End", though you can still click to skip manually through each section.
[/list]
[*] Mom Challenge Initiation
[list]
[*] Level 10 is being developed, but with this hotfix comes the groundwork for accepting Mom's final Challenge.
[*] After you have won all four sub-category awards at the T-Pose Award Show, mom pops up and offers you her Final Challenge.
[list]
[*] Or if you've already finished the To-Do list and delayed her Challenge, but don't create an Award-Eligible film, she will still prompt you again for a challenge.
[/list]
[*] You have the option to delay it for 6 weeks or….well that's it. The option to accept it will be there when level 10 is out!
[/list][/list]

notes.title: Small Update: Level 7-9 Balancing & Fan Convention Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hello Animators, I've got a small balancing patch for you here!

[h3]Small Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Renamed the Blue Clipboard "Studio" instead of "Crew" to more accurate describe it.
[*] Ensure that Mom doesn't win the same Sub-Award twice in a row during the T-Pose Awards	
[/list]
[h3]Balancing for Levels 7-9[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered the Instant and Royalty Payouts for the two big TV series. They were a bit OP after the last update.
[*] Increased the punishment for failing to win anything at an Awards Show.
[*] Added better indication that "Entourage" is coming in the next big update.
[*] Fan Rating starts to Decay in Level 8, based on the difficulty level and your Corruption
[*] You must create one of all three sizes of Fan Conventions (see next section)
[/list]
[h3]Fan Convention Revamp[/h3]
[list]
[*] To start a Fan Convention, first you make a few selections. You choose size of the venue, the quality of the food and entertainment, how much you will spend on Ads & Deals and how many days the Convention will last.
[*] Next, you pay the initial Money fee, Ads & Deals, and you earn the Fan Rating right away since you are "announcing" the event, and the Producer can begin preparing the Convention. The length of time is based on the factors you selected, as well as whether or not you paid to "Rush" the preparation.
[*] While Preparing and Running a Fan Convention, your new level 8 Fan Decay is reversed, and you slowly gain Fan rating instead.
[*] Once the Fan Convention has been prepared, it begins automatically. Now it uses the entire Production Room, instead of just half of it, but you gain the perk of EVERY Fan Film you create during the Fan Convention will go Viral and make extra money!
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update: Level 9! Rebalancing! Tutorials!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Animators and welcome to the GREAT BIG UPDATE!![/h3]

When Animation Studio Manager first entered Early Access a few months ago, I got lots of feedback from streamers and players. They liked the potential of the game, but it was rough. Over the last several months, I've been working hard to add tutorials, rebalancing and add lots of depth to the first 8 levels.

Additionally, level 9's initial rollout has begun! There are a couple level 9 features that aren't finished yet and will be included in another update coming in a few weeks - in fact, I'll be releasing a "Road Map to Completion" next week!

But for now, let's dive into the full list of updates:

[h2]Level 9![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/e2638738b6adfbdc2899316dd189c8f04a1042d3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Now when you finish level 8 and click on the To-Do list, it continues on to level 9!
[*] Mom pops up to note that you two are now rivals and enemies.
[*] Instead of choosing a normal Corruption Perk, you are given a final Perk based on your current 
[*] The Publicist now has access to his Level 9 Booster
[*] Production Employees now have their level 9 Awards Upgrades
[*] The final Media type is unlocked: 'Awards Bait Film'.
[/list]
[h3]T-Pose Awards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/b573180eb441bb70004afd4841dac089d21b7930.png[/img]
[list]
[*] As Mom notes during the Level 9 sequence, you are now competing against Mom!
[*] The Awards go like normal, except you have more Coins for Pontification and must answer a few more questions for the Paparazzi.
[*] There will be an additional minigame in the next update as well.
[*] Mom texts you to briefly taunt each time she wins an Award
[*] Mom will always win the Best Picture Award while you're in Level 9, and she should win at least one of the sub-category Awards as well. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/42ab31541a6776dea35c218c81e35527a13e723e.png[/img]
[h3]P.R. Disasters[/h3]
As a full-blown Studio, you have a lot of moving pieces and sometimes things go wrong. That's what these Disasters are all about.
An issue will arise involving a piece of Inventory (Dialog, Storyboards, Scenes, or Designs) and you have three choices to deal with it:
[olist][*]Ignore it and Sacrifice some Employees. Depending on your XP Loyalty, you could lose nearly half of your Employees in each Department.
[*]Ignore it and Sacrifice your Fan Rating. Depending on your Minimum Fan Rating Soul Perk level, you could lose up to 50% Fan Rating.
[*]Fix the issue. If you started Level 9 with the Pure Perk, you'll need 100 of the problematic Inventory and 250 Positive PR. If you got the Corrupt Perk, you'll need 500 of the Inventory, 500 PR, $1,000,000 and 4 Soul Portions. 
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/daba21f9ad3f2e6bbd56e7e067d8a0bac6bb3f62.png[/img]
[h2]Computer Apps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Inventory Market Buy/Sell complete rebalance
[*] Several Apps got a Help Button that explains the App a bit. 
[*] New App - Plant the Seeds of Pontification
[list]
[*]At level 8, you get an App that allows you to "mention" a Genre each week to start the judges thinking about that Genre.
[*]You can do this once each week between Awards Ceremonies (6 weeks). If you pick the same Genre each week and then submit an Awards Film with that Genre, they judges have a much greater chance of picking that Genre as their favorite, giving you bonus Award Points. (combine this with the Writer's levels 7 & 9 upgrades to guarantee they will love your work!)
[*] Your mentions reset each Award Show, though, so you must come back each week.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/f7a8a5fd710190d291af7eee1e4155913043dc50.png[/img]
[*] New App - Finding Balance
[list]
[*]At level 8, you get an App that allows you to trade Rotted Potato Score for Finding Balance minigame points.
[*]In the minigame, you are trying to reach 100 Points in each bucket. For every 10% Rotted Potato Score you trade in, you start with 5 points in both buckets.
[*]You can trade 10% each week between Awards Ceremonies (6 weeks), but the starting score resets each Award Show, so spend your Potatoes wisely and come back each week to keep boosting your score!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/cbe429a0b578119361ab507003a6b36eae65c358.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Minigame Updates:[/h2]
[h3]Hackers / Virus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Overall
[list]
[*]Happen more frequently now, based on your game mode (Easy, Medium, Hard)
[*]I.T. and Security Toggles have also been increased to match these more frequent attacks. .
[*]The more corrupt you are, the more likely you are to get Hackers/Viruses. Especially in Medium and Hard modes, corruption can even allow Hackers/Viruses overwhelm the Toggles
[*]Added a variable to ensure a week between hackers/viruses
[/list]
[*] Hackers
[list]
[*]Added a down arrow for Hackers, so you can drop the number down, without having to go around the dial
[*]Since the code is non-repeating, it now prevents you from selecting a number that has already been confirmed to be part of the code
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/0f432cb8f9e16adea37eec599c1d17cd9a0dbfe8.png[/img]
[*] Virus
[list]
[*] Now flashes the word "GO!" at the beginning of the game to ensure players know to begin.
[*] Better instructions for clarity, including some pictures for reference
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Awards Minigames:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hot Seat Minigame
[list]
[*] A lot more Hot Seat questions.
[*] The answers that used to give 0 points now give 5 Points.
[/list]
[*] Finding Balance:
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/c011dd0f7e8fe7f273c092517fd8e3d3f2b3b2b8.png[/img]
[*] Clarified instructions
[*] Added a 3 second count-in before the game starts
[*] Added sound effects for winning or losing.
[*] Made Easy Mode a little easier by removing the "15" point options that fall.
[*] Added a little more time to the ending results because they were too fast to read.
[*] Side bars GLOW when you catch their basket.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Overall Rebalancing[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/058c9fc3faf2d3fe6c276259bfd5dc6fa925e406.png[/img]
[*]Corruption/Soul Restoration:
[list]
[*]Hiring Fees. Doubled the impact that Corruption has on Hiring Fees
[*]Corruption Perk: XP. Dropped XP amount to 25XP for Slightly Corrupt and 100XP for Corrupt
[*]Slightly lowered the Cash payout for the levels 7 & 8 Pure Level Perks
[*]Due to Inventory Market rebalancing, Soul Restoration using Themes has been reduced back to its previous cost of 250 Themes
[/list]
[*] Employee Bays
[list]
[*]Quality Control's Bay size has been reduced to match the Artist and Composer, as that is closer to the actual ratio needed. 
**Due to this change, if you load a saved game, you will only have the Quality Control Department head, but none of your Employees.**
[*]Editor & Sound Design Bay prices have gone up slightly, but Quality Control's Bay price went down
[/list]
[*] Media/Film Inventory Requirements
[list]
[*]Slightly balanced Ads/Deals & Publicity for Films
[*]Lowered Animation Requirements overall
[*]Increased Story Requirements to more closely match Animation throughout
[*]To make Approvals/Quality Control less confusing, the number of Approvals is now more closely aligned with the other materials instead of being 4X higher. However, to compensate, that means Q.C. now works 4X slower. So basically, this doesn't change the economy at all, it just makes things less confusing. 
[/list]
[*]Extra Credit
[list]
[*]Balanced Media Requirements to match new 'Make Media' ratios
[*]Increased XP output in level 2 to 25XP.
[/list]
[*]Full TV Seasons
[list]
[*]Increased amount of XP earn from Full Seasons to 50 / 100 / 250 / 500
[*]At level 4, only the 11-minute TV Season unlocks to help focus the player on completing one season.
[*]After creating the first Season, the Executive pops back up to explain that you can build your next season, but can't release another 11-minute until the previous one is canceled or renewed.
[*]The 22-minute TV Seasons unlocks at level 5 and is now part of the To-Do list
[*]The other two TV Seasons unlock at level 6, and the Streaming series is part of the To-Do list as well.
[/list]
[*] Swag Bag
[list]
[*] Lowered costs of starting high tier from 250 Inventory to 100.
[*] Now Inventory requirements increase by 15 every time you use it.
[*] Perk values reduced from 5%/10% to 2%/5%
[/list]
[*] To-Do List
[list]
[*] Level 3 now requires 4 more Writers instead of 2.
[*] Level 5 now requires you make another Season of TV.
[/list]
[*] Achievements
[list]
[*] Genre Achievements have all been reduced to 10
[*] Total Media Achievements have been reduced to 500 / 2500
[*] Total Awards Achievements have been reduced to 10 / 25 / 50
[*] "Cream of the Crop" now requires a Rank 5 employee in all Corporate Departments as well as 
Production Departments
[*] 17 new Achievements, mostly related to newer features.
[/list]
[*] Fans
[list]
[*] Fan Demands happen slightly less frequently when your corruption is low, and more frequently as it gets higher.
[*] Ignoring the Fan Matching Game after level 6 now results in a loss of Fan Rating as well.
[/list]
[*] Increase Production Upgrade: Corporate Training from 10XP to 25 XP
[*] If you go Bankrupt, you lose all Employees EXCEPT Department Heads. Previously, you lost all Department heads except the Producer.
[/list]
[h2]Random Fixes/Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/da407cffba4b0a355fbada370a6765083c1ecf1b.png[/img]
[list]
[*]  Hover over the "Risky Business" or "Catch a Break" navigation tabs, and a Popup appears showing you any active Perks, plus how long they will still be active.
[*]  Added a fourth page to the Employee Clipboard for the Awards. Awards were previously stuffed at the bottom of the Media page, but it was way too crowded
[*]  Level Up Article
[list]
[*] Has been clarified to be written by the Paparazzi News, which ties into the Paparazzi questioning you in the Awards Show.
[*] The 3 news links on the right side of the Article now show tips when you hover over them.
[/list]
[*]  Added a little movement to the tutorial characters so they're not just staring at your blankly!
[*]  Added P.R. Disasters to the Help App
[*]  The Media Tablet no longer has the "Film" button until you hit level 5 since you can't make them until then.
[*]  Level 5 Tutorial - If you are playing with the tutorial on, after the Producer shows you the first two Corporate hires, the Executive takes over to show you where Corporate Training is, and shows you how to access Films on the Media Tablet.
[*]  Level 7 Tutorial - The Executive explains a few things about winning awards. If you lose the awards show, the producer has a meeting right away (instead of waiting for the second failure)
[/list]

[h2]Old saved games[/h2]
Since things are really close to wrapping up with this update and the next - I will be cleaning up some code including some variables to allow old version save files to still work. As long as you load/save your files before the next update, you'll be fine. If you don't load those old games, then they will be deleted.

notes.title: Executive & Corporate Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello and Happy Holidays![/h1]

This update focuses on balancing and updating Corporate as well as clarifying a few points!

[h2]More Character Immersion[/h2]
[b][h3]New Year[/h3][/b]
When the New Year rolls around, either your Mom (levels 1-4) will pop up and use your Studio as a charity tax  write-off, or Chad (levels 5+) will awkwardly tell you Happy New Year before telling you to get back to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/39403c2e3ed5875c76119c2dfa2a14ebd6e9f9c4.png[/img]
	
[b][h3]Executive Tutorial[/h3][/b]
Since the Executive is a friend of mom's you get the first one for free (just like the producer). She also instructs you on two topics:
[list]
[*] At Level 4 you can start to make Full TV Seasons
[*] At level 6 you unlock your first Add-Ons
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/73831801f26a87248c4721333297c2d47c21b99e.png[/img]

[b][h3]Producer Tutorial[/h3][/b]
The Producer now instructs you on three topics if you're having trouble:
[list]
[*] At Level 5+, the first time your Corporate Issues get above 25%, the producer pulls you into a quick meeting to make sure you notice. This replaces a previous Pop-Up
[*] At level 6+, you can start getting Boycotted if your Fan Rating is too low. The first time this happens, the Producer lets you know what you need to do to fix it.
[*] At Level 7+, if you fail an Awards Show (as long as it's not the first time when your mom is guiding you), the Producer will let you know how you can improve your Awards Points next time.
[*] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/0adda0db1c46f05eb5b92e932c18e1e57b2350a5.png[/img]
	
[h2]Employee Bays[/h2]
Just like in the Production Room where you can see each Department's Employees in their Bays, you can now see them in Corporate as well.
	
If you resume a previous save game, your current Corporate Employees should all become Rank 1 and should be visible in their Bays. Corporate bays don't need to be upgraded, they start at full capacity.

[list]
[*] Your Corporate crew will Rank up
[*] Individual Employees will get sick instead of the entire Department
[*] Track Walk-Outs / Poached Employees
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/e4a4f169b310c004d789872744a422acbb161adc.png[/img]
	
[h2]Corporate Crises[/h2]
Previously, there were three types of Corporate Crises - Employee Fights, Computer Viruses and Hackers. However, these would just pop up and last 24 hours and there was nothing you could do about it, which was…pointless. 
	
Now Employee Fights have been removed, since Happiness is being impacted by enough other things, but the other two issues now prompt a quick challenge. How well you do at the challenge determines how many issues you receive. 
	
If you have the IT and Security toggles enabled, you are less likely to receive hacks/viruses, however, the more corrupt you are, the more likely you are to receive them.

[b][h3]Hackers[/h3][/b]
You are prompted to figure out a 5 digit code. Using brute-force guessing, you get three attempts to enter the correct code. If you get any digit of the code correct during any attempt, that digit locks into place.
	
[list]
[*] You can pay a large bribe to get the full code.
[*] You can pay a small bribe to get the first 2 digits.
[*] You can pay nothing, and get no hints.
[/list]
	
The punishment is reduced for each digit you have figured out, and if you figure out all 5 digits, there are no Security issues. 
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/6031e929ec1e18286dbc956e6ed961ac57bd8c97.png[/img]

[b][h3]Viruses[/h3][/b]
You are shown 3 obscured/corrupted images of Inventory items. The image fades out as a timer counts down from 9. The faster you can correctly identify the Inventory, the fewer issues you will receive.
	
[h2]To-Do List:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial To-Do list now lists Editor above Animator since that's what you are instructed to hire first
[*] Level 4 To-Do List replaces "10% Rotted Potatoes Score" with having the Executive throw 5 Departments Parties.
[*] Level 6 To-Do List increases 40% Rotted Potatoes Score to 50%
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Your odds at a good Risky Business pull are increased the more corrupt you are. This is still true, but the numbers have been toned down a little - way too many jackpots were being won!
[*] Award Show points that your opponents had were a bit too high in medium and hard modes, and have been balanced slightly. 
[*] Skipping to Friday makes your Employees sad…but it was way to sad. It has been toned down from -5% to -1%
[*] Executive speed for increasing Rotted Potatoes score has been increased by a factor of 5.
[/list]

	
[h2]Random Changes/Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the Starting year to 2022 to match when the game will be coming out of Early Access.
[*] Added 40 new Questions to the Hot-Seat Minigame for more variety.
[*] Added more variety to each section of Chad's random meeting - especially when you pick your topic for the "metaphor". Previously it was always the same set of topics, now it randomly chooses from 6 sets of topics.
[*] Added the current number of episodes below the "Add to Season" button to show your current progress (i.e 2/24)
[*] If you click "Quick Brew" in the Coffee Room, it now plays the Sound FX just like when you click the actual Coffee Brew button. ("Quick Brew" doesn't play the Sound FX normally to avoid too many overlapping noises)
[*] Added a prompt to remind you to manually save after reloading a crashed autosave game - it will only reload the one time, so be sure to manually save if this happens!
[/list]
	
[h2]Random Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few minor typos and graphical/layering issues
[*] Fixed a glitch where the game and ambient audio would start automatically if you skipped the tutorial
[*] Fixed a glitch where the Tutorial XP Clipboard wouldn't close properly if you tried to open another Clipboard before unlocking the XP Clipboard
[*] Fixed a glitch where Marketing, Distribution and Marketing displayed text that falsely indicate they were still only making 1 inventory item per week after the Corruption Perk had been selected (when it should be doubled).
[*] Fixed a glitch where the Publicist would do his Fan duty when the QC option was selected instead of his own button
[*] Fixed a glitch where the Season Renewal would always show your first show first, even when another show was being renewed/cancelled.
[*] Fixed a glitch where Corporate Department's Happiness wasn't turning red when it was below 70%
[*] Fixed a glitch where it was possible for a Department to get sick when they were already sick.
[/list]

notes.title: Story Update & Early Game Rebalancing
notes.notes:
Happy weekend!

There's lots of fun stuff in this update, so let's unpack it. 

Note - because there are so many changes to the early game, for the first time I am wiping Game-Saves. This won't impact achievements or anything, just any current games in progress. I have avoided doing this and have been able to implement new changes so far without losing save games, but at this point there have been so many changes, I felt it was better to start fresh!

[h1]The Storyline[/h1]
The storyline of the game has been present, but fairly minimal so far - your Mother is a big-shot Producer and you are following in her footsteps...but she has no confidence in you.

This update takes you a lot deeper in that story

[h2]Mom Creator / Tutorial[/h2]

The Mom intro has been revamped and she is no longer a shadowy figure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/8a6e5a729265a387f2780c3d78dc57e069eda992.gif[/img]

When you start a new game, you also get to design your Mom and name her. She is your Guide and Nemesis throughout the game. 

[b]Levels 1-3 have been heavily rebalanced and sped up [/b]as Mom guides you to a full Production Studio.
[list]
[*] Level 1 is now a simple tutorial where Mom guides you through hiring your first 12 Employees, and making your first few pieces of Media.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/12a4ecc8dfe3e4d821855854d9c1f42d9a6e4aac.png[/img]
[*] Level 2 is unguided (Mom leaves and will come back once you've finished the level), but the To-Do list is more explicit in it's direction. You are free to do things your own way, but if you follow the To-Do list, it will guide you through the level quickly and help you understand the dynamics of the different Departments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/4eae0172decf03b0122d7b1777ae8f4a151a04a9.png[/img]
[*] In Level 3 Mom gives you her last advice and leaves. She is too busy to babysit you and is honestly surprised you're not bankrupt yet. This To-Do list has been rebalanced as well.
[/list][b]After that, Mom leaves you in the hands of a couple of her friends - an Executive and a Producer -[/b] who will guide you through levels 4-6 as you build up your Crew and hire a Corporate staff and prepare to start winning Awards at levels 7-8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/4ca80e9e7548de49b54370ded74bb1920b62b117.png[/img]
[h2]Corruption Pathway[/h2]
One of the major themes of the game is the idea that it's easier to get ahead in the Industry through corruption and shady deals than it is through quality artwork! Your Mom has clearly taken the pathway of Corruption, and following her would certainly make it easier to win Awards...but it comes at the cost of your Employee and Fan Happiness.

At the beginning of each level, you'll see a new article that mentions your Studio's rise under your Mom's supervision. The article will comment on your Corruption choices as the game goes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/6cd0e3d0b92130655e246608907e793ea3c85461.png[/img]

Following this article, you will be [b]presented with a choice[/b]:
[list]
[*] A simple one-time Money payout
[*] A permanent Perk like reducing the cost of Employee Salaries or increasing Media Royalty
[/list]Of course, the Perk option will begin to Corrupt you. Corruption will only have a minor impact at the beginning, but as you go, your choices will start to add up with things like lowering happiness, making employees more likely to walk-out or get poached, and giving you less time to handle the Fan Demands of Level 8. These issues will compound greatly in the future level 9 (not currently available) when you start dealing with PR disasters.

[h2]Selling Your Soul[/h2]
Corruption is also now connected to the current "selling your soul" features (you are able to trade portions of your Soul for Perks or Loans).

Selling your Soul now also contributes to your Corruption Level. You can restore your Soul Pieces, but the Corruption is permanent. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/460c5684bc362871494d5d240cc8bd689574a8c8.png[/img]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

As always, due to updates or player feedback, things get balanced around a bit!

[b]Animators [/b]

This was a highly requested issue as Animators are the biggest bottleneck of production - the number of Animators on a real production greatly outnumbers the rest of the departments - so for gameplay, I'm balancing it a little better. [list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/a159e1d2ee1fe969a24e91728f904176007d2b4c.png[/img]

[*] Now you only need to start with 4 Animators per Editor instead of 5 per Editor. Especially as you need a higher percentage of Animation in the future, this should dramatically reduce the number of Animators you need overall.
[*] Since the Animators are now working 20% faster, I always increased their salary by about 15% as well. This makes them slightly cheaper overall, but not a whole 20% cheaper!
[*] As part of this issues, there is also a new [b]4th Coffee Brew.[/b] The previous Perk (Rotted Potatoes Score increase) has been replaced with a new Animator's Brew. The rest of the crew still get the Happiness and alertness from the Coffee, but only the Animators get a big speed boost!
[/list]
[b]Soul[/b]
[list]
[*] Soul Restoration has now become significantly cheaper, only costing $250,000 or 250 themes instead of $1,000,000 or 1,000 themes.
[*] To compensate for new changes, the Soul Perk about Happiness has been dramatically increased
[/list]
[b]Extra Credit[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of inventory required for levels 2-4 Extra Credit as it was too high to be enjoyable.
[*] Increased the amount of XP earned for each item.
[/list]
[b]Full Seasons[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/60cf46cead146eebae53b9d8e468861eb1a571cd.png[/img]

[*] They now unlock at level 4 (instead of 2, which was way too early) with the Executives when you're really building up.
[*] Seasons also now make over twice as much money, making them much more valuable, and worth the longer build time.
[/list]

[h1]Player Widget / New Clipboard[/h1]

[b]The Phone [/b]has been completely removed from the game. It wasn't easy to read, and now with the new Tutorial and Pop-Ups, it has been rendered useless.

The [b]Perks and Pains[/b] icon has also been relocated. This would help you track which Perks were currently active, but due to its difficulty to access/read, many players weren't even aware of its purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/6891f7fdddffb7a8e0850db34866834c9c9befbf.png[/img]

It has now taken the place of the Blue Clipboard, which was also starting to lack purpose due to other updates. The blue clipboard has three tabs at the top so you can track anything that's impacting Speed / Media Sales / or Employee Salary and Happiness. 

[h1]Random[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a glitch where XP Sickness wasn't reducing the chance of getting properly
[*] Increased number of Producer Retraining Pods from 3 to 4.
[*] Fixed a glitch that was causing some Catch a Break Perks to not activate properly
[*] New Achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Animation Studio Manager Early Access Release Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Early Access Release Build of Animation Studio Manager![/h2]

[b]Greetings! Thank you for coming, I hope you enjoy the game![/b]

I've been hard at work the last few weeks finishing up the last of some new features and fixes as well as implementing some improvements based on some recent new player feedback!

One of the biggest issues was that the explanations for things were done via wall of text, so I fixed this by heavily reducing text and adding picture explanations for simplicity:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/e8ee415b4356e4a3f88ac5e7e77a57bd77234c1d.png[/img]

[h2]New![/h2]

[h3][b]Seasons[/b][/h3]
You can now choose to either make TV episodes now, or save them for use in a Full Season.
[list]
[*] Once you've created the full Season, you'll make a lump sum of money as well as weekly Royalties for the 12 weeks the season releases.
[*] Making Seasons is how you earn XP now as well
[*] Once a Season has finished airing, it might get renewed based on your Fan Rating and how long the show has been running.
[list]
[*] If it gets renewed, you have 4 weeks to begin the second season - otherwise it will just start over with a new series. 
[*] Note, you will be able to "design" your Season box set (similar to how you can currently design the Posters for your Award Nominees, but that's only Levels 7+…this brings the personalization to early game!)
[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/8f1f80b41c0d41c1a4898c2ae247b4747a097a2a.png[/img]

[h3][b]XP Revamp[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] XP has been completely reworked to be earned from created TV Seasons in level 2+
[*] XP can be used for several Studio-wide upgrades that will be available early game. [i](not active yet)[/i]
[*] XP can be used to give Corporate Training to Production Employees at Level 5
[*] XP can be used to give Award-Level upgrades to Production Employees at Level 7 [i](not active yet)[/i]
[/list]

[b]Poaching[/b]
If your Employees are unhappy, they might walk out, but before that, they now might get poached by your competition!

[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
Added 10 new Steam Achievements - 5 of them are related to the new TV Seasons.
Brings total to 30 Achievements - all should be currently obtainable.

[h2]Fixes/Balancing[/h2]

[h3][b]Balancing[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The first few levels have few items, so the time now goes by a bit faster to compensate. By level 5 it flattens back out to where it is, but that helps the first few levels flow even better
[*] Optimized a few things throughout the game.
[*] Minor balancing for Fan Rating and Rotted Potatoes
[*] Fan Matching Minigame, change scoring slightly:
[list]
[*] For every pair of matches found, you can +.3% Fan Rating
[*] For every time you miss, though you lose -.1% Fan Rating.
[*] This puts the score range of the game from -0.3% (no matches, all fails) to 1.5% (5 matches, no fails)
[/list]
[/list]		
[h3][b]Fixes / Quality of Life[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the "Catch a Break: Falling" bucket corners - previously it would bounce-out items that seemed like they should go in
[*] Fixed a memory leak that was causing lag spikes after a while.
[*] Fixed a glitch in the "View All" room where, if you click on a spot that is currently empty, but where a future poster might be, it still acts like it's clicking on something now.
[*] Fixed a glitch where if you were in the Risky Business or Catch a Break Room when they Banker Email went off, it would glitch when returning you to the room.
[*] "Skip to Friday" now closes the Media Tablet and Matching Games, so you can't continue to play those while skipping.
[*] When being alerted to a Boycott/Viral, it closes the Media Tablet. Now it reopens the Media Tablet after you close the alert.
[*] Fixed a glitch where the keyboard hotkey the "XP Board" was able to be triggered prior to unlocking XP.
[*] Risky Business
[list]
[*] Fixed a glitch that would give you Inventory for Departments that weren't unlocked yet.
[*] Fixed a glitch that would give "Coffee" perks and pains even if Coffee wasn't unlocked yet.
[/list]
[*] Risky Oops!
[list]
[*] One of the outcomes of pulling the Risky Business lever is the "Oops" option, which results in one of the fog, water, flashlight or multi-color lights.
[*] If you don't use Risky Business for a week, though, the following week you run the risk of the Lever pulling itself and giving you one of the Oops outcomes!
[*] You also won't be able to use Risky Business again that week if it goes off on its own.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Mom [/b][/h3]
Mom is the primary antagonist of the game who starts skeptical and doubtful of you, and turns jealous as the game goes on. I made some changes to make this more apparently through the game.

I plan to add a Character Creator option, where you will also get to design your Mom. For now, though, she is this shadowy figure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/d8562d734ccb7089ab957f71eeead43d7feb29b4.png[/img]

[h3]Early New Player Feedback[/h3]
	A few new players have played recently, and I have adjusted some things as a result.
[list]
[*] Game Instructions - Overall, the instructions weren’t great. Text descriptions were too wordy, and everything was text. It needed pictures and a little more guidance on how to get started and "what to do next".
[list]
[*] Overall reduction of "wordiness" throughout the game's instructions and pop ups. Less is more … too much text and people stopped reading completely.
[*] Office Room now includes "Mom's Rules For Not Failing Your Company" for the first few levels to add to Mom taunting you, and to add to the hints.
[*] New Room Instructions now include pictures and far fewer words
[/list]
[*] No More Variable Speed - The game previously had 3 gamespeeds, creatively labeled speed 1, 2 and 3. Some players were missing that they could go faster and were annoyed with the delay, and once they realized they could speed up, almost never wanted to go slower. So now, previous "Speed 3" is the only speed. If you need to catch up on things, press pause (or spacebar)
[*] Employee Intros: Some players were confused by the Employee Introduction appearing before you had hired one, so I delayed that appearing until you hired the first Employee of that department.
[*] Employee Ratios: Many players aren't reading the Employee speeds and realizing you need more Animators than Writers/Editors. This is leading to slow and bankrupt plays. I Updated the level 1 To-Do list to indicate you should hire 1 Writer, 5 Animators and 1 Editor to help you realize you need different ratios of different employees. After that, no ratios are directly given.
[*] Button Sizes: I made some buttons larger so they stand out more, and are easier to click!
[*] Widget PopUps (Phone, Soul Selling, Perks). When you hover over the phone Icon, the phone pops up. The phone stays visible, even if your mouse moves up to the phone to follow along as you read the text.
[*] Giant Pause button - Players were often not noticing the game was paused, so when in the production or corporate rooms, and the game is paused, a giant "PAUSE" icon fades on the screen for a couple seconds on an interval. Hopefully it's not intrusive, but helpful!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047820/239febb944ee08c24c22836b38fc5a35fd1b775b.png[/img]
			
	
[h3][b]Coming Soon[/b][/h3]
	
I wanted to make sure it was clear which features weren't currently available, so I marked them with a "Coming Soon" or similar tag. 
This includes:
[list]
[*] Volume Control
[*] Studio XP upgrades
[*] Main Menu Minigames
[*] Levels 9 & 10
[/list]
